nonblocking_findings: N1 (process note, Red evidence): the two remediation test files have no recorded Red run. Commits a510c9492 and e52cefc53 each mix the new test file with the production change, and neither the green log nor plan.md records a red count at 9619b9548. The structural red-ness holds: both pinned error strings ('staged baseline delta without a review record', '--budget-s must be a positive whole number of seconds: <value>') exist only in the new code, so the refusal and message cases fail at the base HEAD. The phase's earlier tasks all recorded red evidence, so the remediation broke that pattern.

N2 (gate seam): assertReviewedStagedDelta sits only in applyArchitectureReconciliation. The lower-level helper applyArchitectureReconciliationForPolicy (policy-write-guard.ts:40) is re-exported through the package index (index.ts: 'export * from "./policy-write-guard.js"') without the gate. No caller bypasses today: grep over non-test source finds the only call at architecture-reconciliation.ts:1267, and the CLI routes through the gated entry. A future direct caller of the exported helper could write the four v2 artifacts without review evidence.

N3 (plan wording, incomplete enumeration): plan.md:238 and green-rem-9619b9548.log:99-100 say the refresh commit 'moved the input snapshot, the implementation and test tree, and the report hash'. The 619aef753 diff also moved reviewSubjectSha256 (5840f9c73 -> 11886f7e5c). The field is derived over the manifest bytes (architecture-reconciliation.ts:833), so it necessarily moves. No claim made is wrong; the enumeration omits one derived value.

N4 (environmental, pre-existing, plan-flagged): the suite case 'exercises repository discovery and the production default boundaries' (architecture-reconciliation-cli.test.ts:225) asserts the repository folder name with /reading-advantage-monorepo$/. It fails in this audit checkout (arch-gate-2), giving 339 of 340. plan.md:242 and the green log name this exact failure mode; no track commit touched the case.

N5 (recorded constraint, judged correct): every later v2 reconcile write is refused while the committed manifest holds the 255/15/162 staged delta with reviews=0 and status=candidate. I verified the two schema rules that make a review record impossible today (v2-manifest-validation.ts:105 REVIEW_EVIDENCE_PATHS name the durable_job_worker_platform_20260713 track; :631 binds evidencePath; :656-658 require the evidence JSON to hold empty delta lists). Fail-closed is the right direction: the alternative is the unreviewed write that Review B F1 rejected. CI and the pin refresh are unaffected (the check and both live v2 runs exit 0), and the plan records the constraint and the deferred follow-up at plan.md:239-245 with the follow-up scope spelled out.

Audit point 1 (gate placement): applyArchitectureReconciliation checks the plan hash, then the acknowledge flag, then rejects non-v2 policy, then calls assertReviewedStagedDelta (architecture-reconciliation.ts:1264), then the write-set guard, then the fresh-preview byte comparison, then the write. No path writes the four v2 artifacts without passing the gate. The preview builder stages the manifest under id 'reconciliation-manifest' (architecture-reconciliation.ts:839-848), the exact id the gate reads (:1184).

Audit point 1 (gate tests): architecture-review-gate.test.ts holds 4 cases. Case 1 asserts the exact refusal message on an unreviewed candidate write with a staged delta; the message string exists only in the a510c9492 diff, so the case fails at 9619b9548 (failing-first, not vacuous). Cases 2 to 4 assert a later control's error and the absence of the gate message, proving pass-through. All 4 pass at HEAD.

Audit point 2 (refused writes): node counts over the committed manifest give baselineAdditions=255, baselineRemovals=15, baselineRenames=162, reviews=0, keys=15, status=candidate. validateReviewSync requires review.evidencePath === REVIEW_EVIDENCE_PATHS[index] (:631) where the paths are measure/tracks/durable_job_worker_platform_20260713/reviews/<role>.md (:105-107), and requires the evidence JSON to bind baselineAdditions/Removals/Renames as empty arrays (:656-658). No review record can validate against the staged 255/15/162 delta, so the gate refuses every later v2 reconcile apply. The plan records this at plan.md:239-245, names the deferred follow-up scope (bind staged deltas in v2 review records, move the frozen evidence paths), and green-rem-9619b9548.log:38-61 states the same. measure/tech-debt.md is at its 50-line cap (wc -l = 50), so keeping the note in the plan is justified.

Audit point 3 (budget messages): parsePinRefreshArguments now throws '--budget-s requires a value' for a missing value and '--budget-s must be a positive whole number of seconds: <value>' for an invalid one (architecture-pin-refresh-cli.ts:113-124), instead of the misleading unsupported-argument message. architecture-pin-refresh-budget.test.ts holds 4 cases: the four invalid values with exact message and the no-unsupported assertion, the missing value, the unknown flag keeping the old message, and --budget-s 9 accepted as 900. All pass at HEAD.

Audit point 4 (N1 fix): 6061bed66 adds non-empty length assertions for baselineRemovals and baselineRenames in reconciliation-manifest-v2.red.test.ts. The committed manifest holds 15 and 162 records, so the assertions carry meaning; they pass in my 4-file run.
